title: Journal view
description:
Goal
- Show a reverse-chronological list of journal entries (text and audio) using JournalsService and JournalModel.

UI behavior
- List displays newest first; each item shows date and text snippet or transcript.
- Audio entries provide inline playback controls and display transcription when available.
- Provide empty, loading, and error states; include retry actions on failures.

Tech notes
- Use React Query for data loading and caching; support pagination or infinite scroll if available.
- Use accessible audio players and ensure transcripts are readable on small screens.

Acceptance criteria
- Journals load and display newest-first ordering consistently.
- Audio entries are playable; transcripts visible when provided.
- Errors are handled gracefully with retries and friendly messaging.

features.title: Journals query and list
features.description: Fetch journal entries via JournalsService; display reverse-chronological list (newest first). Support pagination or infinite scroll if backend provides it. Use React Query for caching and background refetching.

features.title: Journal list item components
features.description: Create renderers for text and audio journal entries. Show date/time, text snippet or transcript, and any metadata. Clicking an item can expand or navigate to detail if needed (MVP may remain in-list).

features.title: Audio playback
features.description: Provide inline audio playback for audio journals using the HTMLAudioElement. Ensure accessible labels, graceful handling of remote URLs, and visible loading/progress states.

features.title: Empty, loading, and error states
features.description: Show skeletons while loading, an empty-state placeholder when there are no journals, and an inline error with retry for failures. Acceptance: states are clear and non-blocking.
